tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on the website and the dashboard.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, settings groups, the dashboard sidebar and bars, inputs, the Command block's header. Set apart from surface by a line border and shadow-raised.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code and command bodies, slider and switch tracks, hover fill on quiet buttons.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel and card borders, table rules, dividers. Decorative only; never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: input and secondary-button borders, unchecked switch outline. At least 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and every *-soft tint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, captions, Facts labels, MACs under a satellite name. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: Pinna's colour: the listening blue. Primary buttons, links, the checked switch, the slider fill, the focus ring. As text, on the three surfaces and signal-soft. In dark it is the device's exact listening colour.

tokens.name: signal-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind signal text: the Listening badge, selected rows, info notices.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a signal fill (the primary button). Dark ink in the dark theme, because the fill gets lighter there.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links in prose. Underlined at rest, so they never rely on colour alone.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline (see the focus-ring shadow). Meets 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: brand-start
tokens.usage: First stop of the mark's gradient, blue. Decoration only: gradient eyebrows, icon tiles, glows. Never controls, links, focus or a state; those stay signal. At least 4.5:1 on the three surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-mid
tokens.usage: Middle stop of the mark's gradient, indigo. Decoration only, as brand-start. Alone, it colours decorative icons and step numbers. At least 4.5:1 on the three surfaces.

tokens.name: brand-end
tokens.usage: Last stop of the mark's gradient, violet. Decoration only, as brand-start; the Thinking phase keeps its own token. At least 4.5:1 on the three surfaces.

tokens.name: listening
tokens.usage: The Listening phase in UI: badge text and dot, chart series. Alias of signal on purpose: the brand colour is the colour of the device hearing you.

tokens.name: listening-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Listening badge.

tokens.name: thinking
tokens.usage: The Thinking phase (Home Assistant is processing). As text, on the surfaces and thinking-soft.

tokens.name: thinking-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Thinking badge.

tokens.name: speaking
tokens.usage: The Speaking phase (TTS or an announcement is playing). As text, on the surfaces and speaking-soft.

tokens.name: speaking-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind the Speaking badge.

tokens.name: timer
tokens.usage: Timers: the timer badge, countdown text, timer arcs drawn on page surfaces. As text, on the surfaces and timer-soft.

tokens.name: timer-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind timer text and caution notices.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Needs attention but works: Home Assistant not connected, voice not subscribed, an update waiting. Shares the amber with timers, as on the device. Always with a word.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind caution text and caution notices.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and the Muted (microphones off) state, and destructive buttons. Muted and error share red, as on the device; tell them apart by word and icon. As text, on the surfaces and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger text: the Muted badge, error notices, field errors.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy and connected: the Home Assistant connected dot, a passed check. Use sparingly; healthy is mostly quiet. As text, on the surfaces and ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind ok text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: The first series in a chart lane. Series take chart-1, chart-2, chart-3 in that fixed order, never by rank. Checked for colour-vision separation on surface-raised in both themes. Phase sections keep the phase tokens.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: The second series in a chart lane. Under 3:1 against surface-raised in light, so name every series in a legend and with a direct label at the line's end; colour never carries it alone.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: The third series in a chart lane. Under 3:1 against surface-raised in light, so name every series in a legend and with a direct label at the line's end; colour never carries it alone.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Grid lines and the time axis in a chart. Recessive: 1px, behind the series.

tokens.name: chart-threshold
tokens.usage: A threshold in a chart, such as the wake word's. Dashed, so it is not mistaken for a series.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a dialog. Never behind a toast.

tokens.name: puck
tokens.usage: The dark device body the Ring is drawn on, in both themes. LED colours are only ever shown on puck.

tokens.name: puck-rim
tokens.usage: 1px rim around the puck so it holds its edge on the dark surface.

tokens.name: led-off
tokens.usage: An unlit LED segment on puck.

tokens.name: led-listening
tokens.usage: Device-exact LISTENING (72,185,255) from pinna-hal anim.rs. Only on puck: 7.5:1 there, 2:1 on surface.

tokens.name: led-thinking
tokens.usage: Device-exact THINKING (168,115,239). Only on puck.

tokens.name: led-speaking
tokens.usage: Device-exact SPEAKING (90,220,230). Only on puck.

tokens.name: led-error
tokens.usage: Device-exact ERROR (239,80,80), the three-flash error. Only on puck.

tokens.name: led-muted
tokens.usage: Device-exact MUTED (255,0,0), the solid privacy ring. Only on puck.

tokens.name: led-amber
tokens.usage: Device-exact AMBER (255,160,0): timer arc and timer ringing. Only on puck.

tokens.name: led-volume
tokens.usage: Device-exact VOLUME (120,200,255): the volume meter arc. Only on puck.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Your Echo Dot, on your network.
styles.usage: Website hero headline. One per page. Below 600px wide, use display-l.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Website section headlines and docs page titles; the satellite name on the dashboard's device page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Dashboard page titles, docs section headings (h2), the wordmark at header size.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Pinna turns the device into a Home Assistant voice satellite with on-device wake word, LED ring feedback and button control.
styles.usage: Website and docs prose, kept to the measure size token.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel and card headings in the dashboard; h3 in docs.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Within about 20 seconds the host should see a new USB device.
styles.usage: Dashboard default for text, buttons and form controls.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Satellite names in lists, field labels, emphasis. Emphasis is weight, never italics.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Home Assistant provisions this key when it adopts the satellite.
styles.usage: Hints under fields, notes under charts, footer text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase (text-transform) eyebrows above sections and Facts group titles. Never for sentences.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Commands, paths, config keys, inline code in prose.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: MACs, versions, uptimes, keys and backend names in Facts and cards. Tabular figures.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Volume and timer readouts. Tabular figures so digits do not jitter while they count.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, badge inner padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between related controls; Facts row gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding, field label-to-input gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; the minimum page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels on the dashboard; notice padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between dashboard sections; page gutter from 900px up.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Website: between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Website: between sections.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Inline code, kbd keys, focus outline on small controls.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the slider thumb's housing.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, notices, Command blocks. The largest box radius; nothing rounder except pills.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills only: phase badges, switch tracks and thumbs, the puck.

shadow.note: Lines separate; shadows add depth. Three shadows exist: the focus ring, a faint lift for raised surfaces, and a stronger one for things that float over the page.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: a 2px gap in the page colour, then a solid 2px signal ring.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces that sit on the page: panels, cards, settings groups, stat tiles, the dashboard sidebar. Always with the line border. In dark it is a top highlight, because a shadow barely shows on a dark page.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Things that float over the page: menus, popovers, toasts and dialogs. Never on cards or panels; they take shadow-raised.

size.note: Fixed sizes that recur across both surfaces.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons inside cards and table rows.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height for buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Touch targets: dashboard controls on phones, the website's primary call to action.

tokens.name: ring-sm
tokens.usage: Ring inside timer rows and table cells.

tokens.name: ring-md
tokens.usage: Ring on a DeviceCard.

tokens.name: ring-lg
tokens.usage: Ring on the device page and in the website hero.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum width of prose (body-l) on the website and in docs.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum content width for website sections and the dashboard.

tokens.name: nav-w
tokens.usage: Width of the dashboard sidebar from 760px up.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the dashboard's phone app bar.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Height of the dashboard's phone tab bar.
